risks.title: Cyberattacks disrupting operations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K with detailed governance by the Audit Committee and escalation procedures. The language emphasizes the criticality of EDR systems and 24/7 monitoring, indicating high exposure. Dependence on an external SOC adds a layer of vulnerability. Highly weighted category.

risks.title: Dependence on tobacco crops
risks.score_rationale: The report mentions the direct impact of volume and quality of burley crops in Africa on performance. Although not stated as a standalone risk, it emerges from key performance factors. The language is factual but implies climatic and agricultural vulnerability. Moderately weighted category.

risks.title: Litigation that could have a material impact
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in Item 3, with acknowledgment that while not expected to be material, an unfavorable resolution could be. Language is cautious but not alarming. Reported annually, indicating stable trend. Medium-weighted category.
